title: SRPO: Setwise Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.08452v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent large language models solve complex tasks by coordinating several policies in a shared environment. However, existing reinforcement learning methods usually optimize each response or trajectory separately, even when several outputs jointly cause one state transition. Consequently, the update unit differs from the action executed by the system. To address this problem, we propose SRPO (Setwise Relative Policy Optimization), which treats the active set the minimal set of outputs consumed by one transition, as one multi-agent action. Specifically, SRPO combines member log-ratios into one cardinality-normalized set ratio, assigns one relative advantage, and clips the set once. This formulation unifies division of labor and joint co-evolution as actions with different set sizes. translated_title: SRPO：面向多智能体大语言模型的集合式相对策略优化
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型通过在共享环境中协调多个策略来解决复杂任务。然而，现有的强化学习方法通常对每个响应或轨迹进行单独优化，即使多个输出共同导致一次状态转移。因此，更新的单元与系统实际执行的动作并不一致。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SRPO（集合式相对策略优化），它将主动集——即一次状态转移所消耗的最小输出集合——视为一个多智能体动作。具体而言，SRPO将成员的对数比率组合成一个按集合基数归一化的集合比率，为整个集合分配一个相对优势，并对集合只进行一次裁剪。这一表述将分工协作与联合共同进化统一为具有不同集合大小的动作形式。在数学推理和多轮搜索任务上的实验证明，该方法为固定、混合以及动态路由的工作流提供了一个统一的训练接口……
tldr: 提出SRPO方法，将一次状态转移所消耗的最小输出集合视为单一多智能体动作进行整体优化，解决了多智能体大语言模型强化学习中更新单元与系统实际执行动作不一致的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes SRPO, which treats the minimal set of outputs consumed by one transition as a single multi-agent action for unified optimization, resolving the mismatch between update units and executed actions in multi-agent LLM reinforcement learning.
